title: Lily Lamb's Cloud Cushion
description: Lily Lamb searches the meadow for the softest spot to rest her tired hooves before bedtime.
character_reference: a fluffy white baby lamb with curly wool on her head, sleepy drooping eyelids, and a polka-dot bow tied around her neck

scenes.narration: The evening stars began to twinkle as Lily stretched her tired white legs across the meadow grass.
scenes.visual: wide shot of a peaceful meadow at dusk with pale purple clouds floating low overhead

scenes.narration: She wanted a resting spot as soft as a cotton pillow, but the grass felt prickly against her fleece.
scenes.visual: close-up of curly white wool brushing against sharp dandelion stems while looking dissatisfied

scenes.narration: She tried curling up under a mossy log, but it was much too hard for her sleepy head.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the small lamb resting her chin uncomfortably on a dark damp piece of wood

scenes.narration: Looking up, she noticed a patch of dandelion fluff drifting gently down on the evening breeze.
scenes.visual: macro view of white seed parachutes floating through the golden twilight air

scenes.narration: She gathered a soft mound of dry moss and scattered fluffy petals into a cozy little nest.
scenes.visual: paws arranging soft green moss and white petals into a neat circular bed on the ground

scenes.narration: Crawling into her handmade bed, she sighed happily as sleep wrapped around her like a warm blanket.
scenes.visual: close-up of closed eyes and relaxed fluffy ears resting deeply into a soft cushion of moss

scenes.narration: Comfort is something we can always create with a little care.
scenes.visual: serene night landscape illuminated by gentle moonlight filtering through clover leaves

scenes.narration: Follow along for more gentle bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: warm glowing close-up of a friendly woodland creature waving happily toward the camera
